docs.description: Modal dialog centred over a scrim for a focused task or decision. 3 variants: type (default, image, wizard) — image adds a media header (show modal-image + image slot); wizard adds a Stepper for multi-step flows. title is a text prop, content is a slot, footer actions use a Button Group. role=dialog with aria-modal=true; focus is trapped, Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger. For two panes use Split Dialog; for a yes/no decision use Confirmation Dialog; for an edge-anchored panel use Drawer.

rules.reason: A modal dialog centred over the Scrim, as the description says: role=dialog, aria-modal, labelled by its title, the focus trapped in it, Escape closing it and the focus returning to its trigger. Its close button is its own, drawn where it is given onClose; its content and footer actions (a Button Group) are the caller's. Drawn in place where the caller asks (`inline`), as the visual checks and a page showing a dialog's content draw it.
